B1_BUILD_ROOT_NOT_FOUND.message: No Maven or Gradle build file was found in the project.
B1_BUILD_ROOT_NOT_FOUND.hint: Run inside a Maven/Gradle project folder, or use --project <folder>.

B1_URL_HAS_CREDENTIALS.hint: Remove the credentials from the URL; use a git credential helper instead.

B1_AUTH_REQUIRED.message: The repository needs a login and git could not sign in.
B1_AUTH_REQUIRED.hint: Sign in to GitHub with "gh auth login" or Git Credential Manager.

B1_CLONE_FAILED.message: Could not download the repository because of a network error (3 attempts).
B1_CLONE_FAILED.hint: Check the network and the proxy (git config --global http.proxy).

B1_COMMIT_MISSING.message: Ref or commit {ref} was not found.
B1_COMMIT_MISSING.hint: Check the branch or tag name; use the full SHA.

B1_CUT_MISSING.hint: Use the FQN or the path of the .java file; similar names are listed above.

B1_CUT_AMBIGUOUS.message: Several classes are named {query} and none was chosen.
B1_CUT_AMBIGUOUS.hint: Use the FQN, for example com.acme.shop.OrderService.

B1_CUT_NOT_TESTABLE.message: {query} is an interface, an annotation, a nested class, or lies in the test folder.

B1_MODULE_MISMATCH.message: Could not tell which module contains the CUT: module root {module_root}, build root {build_root}.
B1_MODULE_MISMATCH.hint: Check the two paths above; use "arrow inspect" to see how ARROW reads the project.

B1_BUILD_TOOL_MISSING.message: The project has no wrapper and this machine has neither Maven nor Gradle.
B1_BUILD_TOOL_MISSING.hint: Install Maven or Gradle, or run "arrow setup".

B1_JDK_MISSING.message: No usable JDK was found on this machine.

B1_DEPENDENCY_RESOLUTION.message: Could not download the project dependencies.
B1_DEPENDENCY_RESOLUTION.hint: Run "mvn -q dependency:resolve" to see the error; check settings.xml and the proxy.

B1_BASELINE_BUILD_FAILED.message: No JDK could compile the project.
B1_BASELINE_BUILD_FAILED.hint: See the first error above; run "mvn -q test-compile" in the project for the full output.

B1_BASELINE_TIMEOUT.message: Building or testing the project took longer than allowed (3 attempts).

B1_TEST_NAME_EXHAUSTED.message: Files _ArrowTest to _Arrow99Test already exist for this class.
B1_TEST_NAME_EXHAUSTED.hint: Delete some of the old test files that ARROW generated.

B1_WORKSPACE.message: Could not copy or delete the working copy (disk space, permissions, path too long).
B1_WORKSPACE.hint: Check the free disk space; set ARROW_HOME to a shorter path.

B2_INVALID_OUTPUT.message: The model did not return usable test code.
B2_INVALID_OUTPUT.hint: Run again, or switch to another model.

B2_TEMPLATE_INVALID.message: A prompt template is invalid: missing or extra placeholders, wrong id, or a broken override file.
B2_TEMPLATE_INVALID.hint: Fix or remove the prompts.override_dir folder.

B2_LLM_UNAVAILABLE.message: Could not reach the model: the network or the provider is failing.

B2_LLM_CONFIG.message: The model configuration does not work (key, account, base_url, model_id or parameters).
B2_LLM_CONFIG.hint: Check it with "arrow models test", then continue with "arrow gen --resume {run_id}".

B2_WRONG_MODEL.message: The endpoint answered with another model: {actual} instead of {expected}.

B2_TOKEN_BUDGET.message: The token budget (--max-tokens) is used up.
B2_TOKEN_BUDGET.hint: Raise the budget, then continue with "arrow gen --resume {run_id}".

B3_TIMEOUT.message: A verification step took longer than allowed (3 attempts).
B3_TIMEOUT.hint: The generated test may hang (endless loop, waiting for the network). Increase verification.step_timeout_seconds or run again.

B3_DEPENDENCY.message: Could not download dependencies while verifying the test.

B3_TOOL_ERROR.message: Maven, Gradle or the JVM could not run, or was stopped midway.

B3_WORKSPACE.message: Could not create or delete the verification copy (disk space, permissions).
B3_WORKSPACE.hint: Run "arrow clean --work"; check the free disk space.

B4_SUITE_COMPILE.message: Could not compile the test suite in the measuring copy (3 attempts).
B4_SUITE_COMPILE.hint: Environment problem; run again. If it keeps failing, report it with the log.

B4_JACOCO_FAILED.message: No coverage data was collected for the class under test.
B4_JACOCO_FAILED.hint: The project may run tests in a separate JVM that ignores JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS. See the log.

B4_PIT_FAILED.message: PIT failed, or no JDK 11 or newer is available.
B4_PIT_FAILED.hint: Install JDK 11 or newer; see the last 20 lines of the log.

B4_PIT_SCOPE.message: PIT created mutants outside the class under test and its nested classes.
B4_PIT_SCOPE.hint: This is an ARROW configuration bug. Please report it with the log.

W_TARGET_OUTSIDE_PROJECT.message: The target path is outside the project or its test folder (symlink, junction, ".."). Nothing was written.
W_TARGET_OUTSIDE_PROJECT.hint: Check the symlinks in the project; report it with the log.

W_PROJECT_CHANGED.message: The source file of the class under test changed since the run.
W_PROJECT_CHANGED.hint: Run "arrow gen" again for that class.

W_REVERIFY_FAILED.message: The renamed _Arrow<k>Test version is no longer VALID.
W_REVERIFY_FAILED.hint: The original is still in runs/. Run "arrow gen" again.

W_TARGET_EXISTS.message: The target file appeared while writing, twice in a row.

W_IO.message: Could not write the test file (permissions, full disk, or a locked file).
W_IO.hint: Check write access to the test folder, or close the IDE that locks the file.

CFG_HOME_PATH.message: ARROW_HOME contains a space or a non-ASCII character: {path}.
CFG_HOME_PATH.hint: Set the ARROW_HOME environment variable to another folder, for example D:\arrow.

CFG_PARSE.message: Config file {file} is not valid JSON (line {line}, column {column}).
CFG_PARSE.hint: Fix the file at that position; "arrow config path" prints where the config files are.

CFG_INVALID.hint: Fix it with "arrow config set {key} <value>" or in the config file above.

CFG_NEWER_SCHEMA.message: Config file {file} was written by a newer version of ARROW.

CFG_SECRET_IN_PROJECT.message: The project file .arrow.json contains an API key.
CFG_SECRET_IN_PROJECT.hint: Remove the key from the file, then use "arrow secrets set <ref>".

CFG_SECRET_MISSING.message: Provider {provider} needs an API key and none was found.
CFG_SECRET_MISSING.hint: Run "arrow secrets set {ref}", or set the environment variable {env_var}.

CFG_TOOL_MISSING.message: Tool {tool} is missing and could not be downloaded.
CFG_TOOL_MISSING.hint: Run "arrow tools install" when the network is available.

CFG_TOOL_CHECKSUM.message: The downloaded file {tool} has a wrong sha256.
CFG_TOOL_CHECKSUM.hint: Try again; if it is still wrong, check the proxy or ARROW_MAVEN_MIRROR.

CFG_DISK_FULL.message: Not enough free space in ARROW_HOME (at least 2 GB needed).

JH_JDK_MISSING.message: java-helper needs JDK 17 or newer, and none was found.
JH_JDK_MISSING.hint: Install JDK 17 or newer, then run "arrow setup".

JH_START_FAILED.message: java-helper could not start, or stopped unexpectedly twice in a row.

JH_TIMEOUT.message: A java-helper command timed out twice in a row.
JH_TIMEOUT.hint: Please report it with the log.

JH_INPUT_TOO_LARGE.message: The code sent to java-helper is larger than 2 MB.

GEN_NO_TARGETS.message: There is no class left to run.
GEN_NO_TARGETS.hint: Check the class or package names.

GEN_RESUME_MISMATCH.message: The project has changed since run {run_id}.

GEN_RESUME_NOT_FOUND.message: Run {run_id} does not exist, or belongs to another project.

CLI_NO_TTY.message: This command needs a keyboard, but the input is redirected.
CLI_NO_TTY.hint: Run the command in an interactive terminal.

CLI_INTERNAL.hint: Please report it with the log file: {log_path}.
